description: PLANNED for OpenVibe.Website Connect (audience openvibe.website, owner or granted app): read the request inspector for a share (GET /api/v1/shares/:id/requests), a bounded ring buffer of the last N requests as website.audit-entry@1 rows plus captured metadata. Bodies, headers and cookies are captured only when the owner opted in, under a separate redaction pass; query strings and tokens are stripped, and this read never returns a secret. The buffer is 24 hours on free and 7 days on paid plans.
